# BoldLine Media

> BoldLine Media is a Phoenix, Arizona agency that plans, builds, and runs Google Ads and Meta (Facebook/Instagram) ad campaigns, plus the custom landing pages behind them, for local service businesses. Clients always own and are billed directly for their own ad account; BoldLine only manages it and never holds or fronts ad spend. Management starts at $350/month; most clients run about $1,000/month or more in ad budget, paid directly to Google or Meta.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://boldlinemedia.com/): what BoldLine does, packages and pricing, how an engagement runs, FAQ.
- [Get Started](https://boldlinemedia.com/get-started/): request a free strategy call.
- [Blog](https://boldlinemedia.com/blog/): plain-English marketing tips for local service businesses (Google Ads, Meta Ads, landing pages, lead follow-up).

## Services
- Google Ads management
- Meta (Facebook and Instagram) Ads management
- Custom landing pages built to convert
- Call tracking and CRM lead routing

## Who it's for
Local and service businesses that want steady, predictable leads without managing ads themselves.

## Owner
Bryson Weiser, founder. BoldLine keeps a small client roster on purpose — clients work directly with the founder, not a junior account manager.
